authoritative_campaign.seed_requirement: Explicit WHIZARD seed before all integration statements

decision: The existing 365 GeV production CSV files are structurally valid but are not adopted as the canonical full-six-fermion Phase 10 production definition.
next_action: Build the canonical Phase 10 production family from the validated full-six-fermion Sindarin renderer and runner, retaining the factorized production framework only as a comparison workflow.
physics_reason: The direct full-six-fermion calculation preserves off-shell, non-resonant, finite-width, and interference contributions that are not generally identical to factorized on-shell ttbar production followed by unstable-particle decays.
